# Moonlighter

## What is this game?
Moonlighter is Moonlighter

## What does randomization do to this game?
Yeah, I wonder

## What Moonlighter items can appear in other players' worlds?
Great question

## Where is the options page?
Currently, there is no options page. You can download the apworld to play [on the latest release](https://github.com/FeluciaPS/Archipelago/releases) and configure it to with the options you'd like.

notes.text:
# Mod download
Download the mod from [Thunderstore](https://thunderstore.io/c/moonlighter/p/FeluciaPS/MoonlighterAPMod/), ideally using r2modman (or the thunderstore mod manager). The latest v0.1.x mod will always be compatible with every v0.1.x apworld.

# Locations
- Every item in the Blacksmith (81)
- Every item from the Hawker (16)
- 2 locations in the tutorial sequence (2)
- 3 locations for reading all of Crazy Pete's notes in the various dungeons (12)
- 1 location for every boss and miniboss in the game (12)
- 1 location for beating a tree until it drops an item (1)
For a total of 120 locations

# Unavailable options
- Goal cannot be set to collector
- Equipment randomizer must be set to progressive
- Death Link does not work in v0.1.0, a v0.1.1 mod update will soon be released that adds Death Link

# Known issues
For an up to date list of issues check out the [known problems list](https://github.com/FeluciaPS/MoonlighterAP/issues/15)
- Some items may be collected more than once (Hawker and Forge items can be bought even if you already own them)
- There is no sprite for progression items, it uses the "useful" sprite instead
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FeluciaPS/MoonlighterAP/compare/v0.0.0-pre-alpha...v0.1.0-beta
